evaluator: Blind Stagebench phase-3 evaluator: measured the published build at 1440x900 with Playwright/Chromium (elementFromPoint probes, DOM geometry, pixel deltaE) and drove the running instrument with an analyser tapped onto the destination connection.
summary: A complete and unusually honest Stage 4. Geometry is effectively exact (deck 0.53997, keybed 0.46000, aspect 3.09513, worst section deviation 0.00001); 147/147 controls pass a 5x5 elementFromPoint probe, all 73 keys sit inside the keybed, and all five reference colours match within deltaE 6.9. All three engines are genuinely different: piano types span centroids 444-1531 Hz (three sampled sets, 9.4 MB of WAV shipped), six organ models span 390-3099 Hz, five synth oscillator categories are spectrally distinct. Everything routes through one shared six-unit chain with per-layer state (Organ A delay wet 10.0 vs Organ B 2.2), one limiter holding peak at 0.894 with zero clipped frames under 17 simultaneous keys across three sections. Programs, Live slots, splits/zones, scenes, morphs, transpose and panic all round-trip and are observable in audio. Deductions: releasing KB HOLD leaves notes stuck, the numeric list view only lights an LED, legends collide in the densest groups, and the organ is ~20 dB hotter than the piano at identical fader positions.

criteria.label: Distinct engine character
evidence: Cycling organ.model and playing C4 gives six measurably different tone recipes: spectral centroids 1794 Hz (B3), 2961, 3099, 995, 2060 and 390 Hz (B3 Bass), with band distributions that differ by 20-30 points, so these are separate generators rather than one oscillator relabelled.

Piano types measured at C4: Grand centroid 1177 Hz, Upright 516 Hz, Electric 1531 Hz, Clav 444 Hz, Digital 521 Hz — plus visibly different envelopes (Clav mean RMS 0.098 with fast decay vs Electric 0.021 with a long tine tail).

Synth oscillator categories at C4: Pure 1528 Hz, Sync 1761 Hz, Multi 1840 Hz, Super 1856 Hz, FM-H 733 Hz; the Pure list steps Saw/Square/Pulse 33/Pulse 10/White Noise with centroids 1457/1275/1422/2566/3531 Hz (src/audio/synthVoice.ts:33 holds exactly the spec's waveform list).

The three sampled piano sets are real assets, not synthesis relabelled: build/samples holds 71 WAVs (grand 3.9 MB, upright 3.7 MB, electric 1.4 MB) and the Program OLED prints RECORDED SAMPLES vs SYNTHESISED per type.

criteria.label: Effects & routing integration
evidence: Organ inherits the shared chain: with Delay on and feedback/mix at max, the post-release tail runs 0.391, 0.389, 0.388, 0.387 RMS instead of 0.0000 dry; Mod 1 (A-Pan) at full amount drops mean RMS 0.3095 -> 0.2196 and shifts centroid 1495 -> 1584 Hz.
Synth inherits the same chain: reverb wet leaves a 0.0032 tail after release where dry is 0.0000, and delay wet raises the release tail to 0.09-0.12 with modulation CV 0.455.
Effect state is per layer, not global: with FX Focus on Organ A the Delay Dry/Wet knob reads 10.0, and switching focus to Organ B the same knob reads 2.2.

Every engine's audio arrived on a single analyser teed onto the one connection to AudioContext.destination, and the master peak sits at exactly 0.894 for organ, synth and 51-voice clusters alike — one shared limiter and destination, as declared.

criteria.label: Musical quality under load
evidence: Note-on latency from a synthetic keydown to the first audible analyser frame measured 8.7 ms and 22.3 ms (2 ms polling granularity).
17 computer-keyboard keys held with Organ, Piano and Synth all enabled: mean RMS 0.581, peak 0.894, 0 clipped frames, and the Program OLED read VOICES 17 live.
Release is clean: after lifting all 17 keys RMS falls to 0.00000 with 0 elements left at data-held=true; window blur while sustaining also drops RMS from 0.176 to 0.00000.
No console errors or page errors were emitted in any of the eleven scripted browser sessions, including the stress passes.

criteria.label: Program & state round-trip
evidence: Round trip verified by value: Reverb Dry/Wet set to 10.0 and stored to 1.1 (OLED 'STORE TO 1.1?' then confirm), edited to 0.0, dial to 1.2 (knob reads 4.5, that program's own value), dial back to 1.1 and the knob reads 10.0 again — edits discarded on program change exactly as the spec requires.

The dirty flag is truthful in both directions: the 'E' indicator appears in the OLED the moment a control moves and disappears after Store; src/state/hardware.ts computes it as !snapshotsEqual rather than tracking a flag.
32 slots over 4 pages with stored factory content: page-right then slot 4 shows 2.4, page-left shows 1.4 VOX COMBO, page 2 slot 1 shows 2.1 THREE ZONE RIG.

Live Mode holds 8 auto-storing slots (LIVE 1 / LIVE 3 in the OLED, no 'E' after editing a Live slot, and the edited level persisted across a slot 5 -> slot 3 round trip); STORE AS opens naming with 'NAME: Grand Piano'.

criteria.label: Performance controls & bindings
evidence: Pitch stick bends real pitch: at stick value 0.4 of a +/-2 semitone range the measured fundamental moved 257.8 -> 269.5 Hz (predicted 270.0 Hz).
Octave shift moved the fundamental 257.8 -> 527.3 Hz and back; sustain via Space keeps RMS at 0.176 after key release; Panic (Shift+Transpose) takes RMS from 0.0207 to 0.00000.

Both morph sources reach the engine: with a Wheel morph assigned to Reverb Dry/Wet the knob tracks 0.0 -> 10.0 -> 0.0 as the wheel travels and the OLED reads MORPH 1; the on-screen Control Pedal drives an assigned Filter Freq 0.0 -> 10.0 -> 0.0.
Defect: turning KB HOLD off leaves the held note sounding — RMS stays 0.0888 at 300 ms, 1 s, 2 s and 3 s after the button is released, with no keys marked held; only Panic clears it.
Web MIDI is denied in a headless browser and the status strip and OLED both say so ('MIDI DENIED') rather than claiming a connection, so MIDI binding could not be exercised here.

criteria.label: Cross-system workflows
evidence: A split really separates two engines: with Split on, Organ A in zone 0 and Synth A in zone 1, E2 renders RMS 0.307 at centroid 652 Hz (organ) while C6 renders RMS 0.060 at centroid 2954 Hz (synth).
Three editable split points exist with crossfade: Shift+Split walks SPLIT LOW C3 XF OFF -> MID C4 -> HIGH C5, and the keybed shows a .keybed__split marker at the active note when split is on.

Layer Scenes behave exactly as the programs spec defines them (enable state only, parameters shared): Piano A off in Scene I, on in Scene II, off again on return, while the shared level stayed at its edited value.
Transpose is audible and displayed: TRANSPOSE +3 moved the measured fundamental 257.8 -> 316.4 Hz (predicted 306.6, one 11.7 Hz bin away) and the OLED read TRSP 3.
Quirk: with Master Clock set mode armed, entering Split edit still routes the Program dial to BPM (dial moved CLK 125 -> 127 while the OLED showed SPLIT LOW C3).

criteria.label: Organ system
evidence: Nine physical drawbars are present and audible: pushing drawbars 1 and 3 in moved the centroid 1977 -> 1126 Hz and cut the sub-150 Hz band from 10.3% to 3.4%; each drawbar carries its own 8-step LED ladder and footage legend.

Percussion and vibrato/chorus change rendered audio, not just LEDs: percussion on moved the centroid 1126 -> 978 Hz and lifted mean RMS 0.324 -> 0.344; vib/chorus on shifted the 400-900 Hz band 24.4% -> 29.1%.
Six organ models (B3, Vox, Farf, Pipe 1, Pipe 2, B3 Bass) are individually selectable and measurably different (centroids 1794/2961/3099/995/2060/390 Hz).
Rotary integration works from the shared Rotary Speaker block: switching speed to Fast raised mean RMS 0.347 -> 0.444 and extended the decaying tail from frame 112 to frame 233.
The one decorative organ control (organ.preset) carries data-functional="false" in the DOM and is declared with the spec clause that excludes it.

criteria.label: Synth system
evidence: All required waveforms exist in the printed order (src/audio/synthVoice.ts:33-39: Pure sine/triangle/saw/square/pulse 33/pulse 10/white noise, Sync x2, Multi x2, Super x2, FM 2-op) and the synth OLED names the selected one live (SAW, SYNC SQUARE, MULTI SAW 8VE, SUPER SQUARE, FM 2-OP).

Filter is real: Freq to minimum drops mean RMS from 0.0601 to 0.0017 and the centroid from 685 to 269 Hz; cycling filter type past BP with the cutoff at maximum leaves 0.00005 RMS, which is the correct physics rather than a label change.

The arpeggiator retriggers: with three notes held under KB HOLD, Arp running gives RMS coefficient-of-variation 0.138 and 12 mean-crossings over 2.5 s versus 0.098 and 3 crossings with the arp stopped.
Three layers with independent state are present (synth.a/b/c level, on, and per-layer chains); switching FX focus from Synth A to Synth B repaints the synth OLED header LAYER A -> LAYER B.

criteria.label: Layers, splits, scenes & morphs
evidence: Seven playable layers exist (Organ A/B, Piano A/B, Synth A/B/C) each with level fader, LED ladder, on/off and octave shift; layer level faders move their cap 0% -> 74% and light 0 -> 12 ladder cells across the range.
Zone assignment cycles per layer through Shift + the layer On/Off button and is observable in audio (organ-only lower zone, synth-only upper zone; the OLED reads SPLIT 2 ZONES).

Morph destinations light a green morph LED and expose data-morphed="true" on exactly the assigned control (fx.reverb.dry-wet, synth.filter.freq), and both Wheel and Control Pedal sources drive them end to end.
Layer Scenes I/II store independent enable configurations within one program and survive scene switching.

criteria.label: Programs & Live Mode
evidence: Store is a two-press flow with a destination prompt ('STORE TO 1.1?' then confirm), STORE AS opens naming ('NAME: Grand Piano'), and page navigation walks 1.1 / 1.4 VOX COMBO / 2.1 THREE ZONE RIG / 2.4 across the 4 pages of 8.
Live Mode switches the eight program buttons to LIVE 1-8 and auto-stores edits (no 'E' indicator after editing, and the edit survived a slot 5 -> slot 3 return).
Master Clock: Shift+MST CLK opens 'MST CLK 120 BPM' and the dial moves it to 125 then 127, with the status line updating to CLK 127.

Gap: the numeric list view required by the programs spec is not rendered — Shift + Program dial changes only 2 characters of the program section's HTML (an LED data-on flip); no list of the 32 programs appears in the OLED or the section.

criteria.label: Chassis, silhouette & geometry

measurements.label: Worst of the six section-fraction deviations

evidence: Measured on the published build at 1440x900, page unscrolled: .instrument 1368.0 x 441.98 px at x=36, .deck 238.66 px tall, .keybed-zone 203.31 px tall — deck 238.656/441.984 = 0.539965 and keybed 203.313/441.984 = 0.459999 against the 0.54/0.46 +/-0.025 targets.
Width fraction 1368/1440 = 0.9500 (inside 0.88-0.97) and aspect ratio 1368/441.984 = 3.09513 against the 3.0951 +/-0.06 target.

The six section widths measured 191.52 / 273.59 / 116.27 / 171.00 / 342.00 / 273.59 px, i.e. fractions 0.140000 / 0.200000 / 0.084991 / 0.125003 / 0.250006 / 0.200000 of the 1367.97 px deck; the worst deviation from the spec's ordered fractions is 0.000009 on the piano section.
The instrument fits without vertical scroll: document scrollHeight equals the 900 px viewport.

criteria.label: Hardware inventory & placement

measurements.label: Required section landmarks rendered in their own section
Controls a pointer can actually operate

evidence: Reachability was measured with a 5x5 grid of document.elementFromPoint probes across each control's bounding box at 1440x900 with the page unscrolled, counting a hit only when the probe resolved to that control or a descendant: 147 of 147 [data-control-id] elements were reachable, and every one resolves inside a [data-section] ancestor (performance 7, organ 24, piano 15, program 28, synth 40, effects 33).

All 33 required landmarks are present in their sections: performance has master level, pitch stick, mod wheel and the 'nord stage 4 / HAMMER ACTION 73' branding; organ has nine drawbars, LED ladders, model switches, percussion (volume/decay/harmonic/on) and the Rotary Speaker block rendered where the reference photograph puts it, immediately left of the organ plate with its source switch reading 'Organ'; piano has layer levels, type selector, model selector, timbre and the acoustics/unison/KB touch/dyn comp detail switches; program has the primary OLED, the large dial, eight program buttons, page navigation, Live Mode, Layer Scene, Store, Split and three morph assign buttons; synth has one OLED, three layer levels, oscillator, filter, envelope, LFO and arpeggiator controls; effects has Mod 1, Mod 2, Amp Sim/EQ, Delay, Compressor, Reverb and the organ/piano/synth focus controls.

No forbidden element appears: the performance area carries no dark inset plate and no display, organ/piano/effects contain zero elements matching oled/display/screen class names, the only two OLEDs are program (79x39 px) and synth (82x42 px), neither spans its section, and no section renders a uniform equal-width knob matrix.

Nine controls carry data-functional="false" (organ.preset, program.morph.aftertouch, the three preset-library buttons, program.solo, program.section-edit, program.mon-copy, fx.delay.effects); each is a control the assigned specs exclude, and they move and report value while touching no audio.

criteria.label: Keybed fidelity

measurements.label: Keys whose box falls inside the keybed

evidence: 73 [data-midi] key elements render, 43 with data-key-color=white and 30 black, matching the Stage 4 73 variant exactly; the keybed group is labelled '73 key hammer action keybed, E1 to E7'.
All 73 key boxes fall inside the .keybed rect (x 77.98-1362.56, y 256.91-442.95) within a 0.5 px tolerance — zero keys outside.

Mean white key height 186.05 px, mean black key height 113.48 px, so the black-key height fraction is 0.609977 against the 0.61 +/-0.03 target; mean black/white width ratio is 0.650 (19.41 / 29.86 px).
Keys respond as buttons with aria-pressed and data-held toggling on pointer input, and pointer depth on the key sets velocity (src/components/Keybed.tsx:25-30).

criteria.label: Chassis & plate colour fidelity
evidence: A 1368x442 screenshot of the instrument was decoded and every distinct RGB value (17,091 of them over 603,288 px) was converted to CIE Lab; nearest-surface deltaE (CIE76) to the spec's referenceColors was chassisMid 0.00 (#851a25 rendered exactly), chassisDark 2.10, panelBlueGray 0.00, keyBlack 0.00, keyWhite 0.00 — all five inside deltaE 12.

Restricting the search to colours covering at least 0.5% of the instrument's pixels (i.e. real surfaces rather than gradient steps) the worst case is still chassisDark at deltaE 6.87 (#6d131c, 3.76% of pixels), so all five match on a surface-area basis too.
The panel plates render at #3c424d exactly (0.81% of pixels) and the white keys at #dcdcdc (0.77%), which are the spec values verbatim.

criteria.label: Materials, legends & displays
evidence: Micro-detail is dense and hardware-specific: 179 individual LEDs (36 lit at power-up), numbered 8-step drawbar ladders with printed footages (16', 5 1/3', 8', 4', 2 2/3', 2', 1 3/5', 1 1/3', 1'), 0-10 tick rings drawn around knobs, alternating white and dark drawbar grips, boxed Shift-function legends (RATE|SENS, MID|RES, GLOBAL) as on the silkscreen, and the 'HANDMADE IN SWEDEN BY CLAVIA DMI AB · v2.0 Rev.B' footer.

Both OLEDs are treated as displays rather than text: cyan monospace lines on a dark panel with a head line, a large program line and a rule (.oled--program 79x39 px, .oled--synth 82x42 px), showing live values.

Weakness measured at 3x magnification: legends collide with group borders and each other in the densest areas — 'FX FOCUS' over the MOD 1 title, Synth 'MENU'/'GROUP' across the Arpeggiator and Vibrato group edges, 'TRIANGLE' over the LFO box, 'STORE AS…' over 'MIDI'/'EXTERN'.
At the rendered 1440x900 size most silkscreen text is 3-4 px tall and unreadable without zooming, so a player reads the panel by shape and colour rather than by legend.

criteria.label: Panel state & displays
evidence: Control positions track their parameters: the reverb knob's --knob-angle moves -135deg to +135deg across its range, the Piano A level fader cap moves bottom 0% to 74% with the LED ladder lighting 0 to 12 cells, and drawbar 1's grip moves top 62% (in) to 0% (out).
LEDs follow system state: turning the Organ section on increases the lit-LED count 36 -> 37, and an assigned morph destination gains a green LED plus data-morphed="true" on exactly that control.

Displays read live values: the Program OLED updates through 'STORE TO 1.1?', '1.2 TINE STACK', 'TRANSPOSE +3 / TRSP 3', 'SPLIT 2 ZONES', 'SCENE I', 'MORPH 1', 'CLK 127', 'VOICES 17' and the RECORDED SAMPLES / SYNTHESISED source line as the instrument is driven.

The Synth OLED follows layer focus and edits: its header repaints LAYER A -> LAYER B when FX focus advances, and it names the selected waveform (SAW, SYNC SQUARE, MULTI SAW 8VE, SUPER SQUARE, FM 2-OP) as the dials move.

criteria.label: Narrow-viewport retention
evidence: At 390x844 the whole instrument is retained rather than collapsed: .instrument renders 377.2 x 121.9 px with all six sections present (performance 53, organ 75, piano 32, program 47, synth 94, effects 75 px) and all 73 keys still inside the keybed.
Nothing clips or overflows the page: documentElement.scrollWidth equals the 390 px viewport and the status strip and controls reflow below the instrument.
A Zoom 1x-4x slider appears only at narrow widths; at 3x the instrument is 1132 px wide inside a horizontally scrollable viewport, which is what makes panel editing possible.
Cost of the strategy: at 1x panel controls are roughly 2 px and only 125 of 147 pass the same 5x5 elementFromPoint probe, so the panel is legible as a picture but needs the zoom to be operated.

issues.title: Releasing KB HOLD leaves notes stuck
issues.detail: With Synth KB HOLD on, a played note correctly keeps sounding after key release (RMS 0.0888). Turning KB HOLD off does not stop it: RMS measured 0.0888 / 0.0888 / 0.0887 / 0.0888 at 0.3 s, 1 s, 2 s and 3 s after the button was released, with zero elements marked data-held. Only Panic clears the voice.

issues.title: Numeric program list view is not rendered
issues.detail: The programs spec requires a numeric list of all 32 programs on Shift + Program dial. Toggling it changes the program section's innerHTML by 2 characters (an LED data-on attribute) and produces no list in the OLED or elsewhere in the section, so the required view exists as an indicator only.

issues.title: Organ section is about 20 dB hotter than Piano at the same fader position
issues.detail: At default program values a single C4 renders mean RMS 0.032 on Piano Grand and 0.316 on Organ B3 with both layer faders at 8/10, so a layered piano+organ program is organ-dominated until the player rebalances. No clipping results (the master limiter holds peak at 0.894), but the inter-section balance is not what the hardware suggests.

issues.title: Legends collide in the densest control groups
issues.detail: At 3x magnification of the 1440x900 render, several legends overlap or spill across their group borders: 'FX FOCUS' over the MOD 1 group title in Layer Effects, 'MENU'/'GROUP' over the Arpeggiator and Vibrato group edges in Synth, 'TRIANGLE' over the LFO box, and 'STORE AS…' over 'MIDI/EXTERN' in Program. At 1x these legends render at roughly 3-4 px and are effectively unreadable.

issues.title: Dial mode priority: Master Clock set outranks Split edit
issues.detail: After arming Master Clock set (Shift + MST CLK) and then entering split editing (Shift + SPLIT), the OLED shows 'SPLIT LOW C3 XF OFF' while the Program dial still edits BPM (CLK 125 -> 127). The displayed edit target and the dial's actual target disagree until clock set is dismissed.

issues.title: Sample source label reads FALLBACK VOICE while a set is still loading
issues.detail: Selecting program 1.2 (Electric / Tine EP) immediately prints 'FALLBACK VOICE' in the Program OLED; after about two seconds the same program reads 'RECORDED SAMPLES'. The transient label understates the state (loading, not failed) rather than overstating it, so the honesty contract is not broken, but the reading is wrong while it lasts.

issues.title: At 390x844 panel controls are about 2 px and depend on the zoom slider
issues.detail: The narrow layout scales the whole instrument to 377 px wide, which keeps every section and all 73 keys but leaves panel controls at roughly 2 px; a 5x5 elementFromPoint probe reaches 125 of 147 controls at 1x. A Zoom 1x-4x slider plus horizontal panning makes them usable (instrument 1132 px wide at 3x), so usability is recoverable but not direct.
